nodes.label: Dev Log: RIS v1 Data Foundation
RIS KnowledgeStore (SQLite Data Plane)
nodes.rationale: 4-table SQLite (source_documents, derived_claims, claim_evidence, claim_relations); stdlib sqlite3 (matches lexical.py, no ORM); freshness decay 2^(-age/half_life) floor 0.3; CONTRADICTS 0.5x penalty downweights not hides; _llm_provider=None blocks accidental cloud calls; no Chroma wiring.

nodes.label: RIS Authority Conflict (LLM API Policy)
nodes.rationale: Roadmap v5.1 allows Tier-1 free cloud APIs for hypothesis/scraper eval; PLAN_OF_RECORD says no external LLM API calls. Code includes _llm_provider abstraction defaulting None; resolution requires operator decision and blocks automatic claim extraction.
